integrity_statement: A standalone Python 3 checker exhaustively reconstructs the finite complex, certifies the acyclic discrete-Morse matching and full integral attaching matrix; the scientific review is self-review only and independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: This proves the integral homotopy type for the ordinary matching complex of one explicit 16-vertex Möbius ladder only; it neither classifies all lengths nor the symmetry action, and it does not address the perfect-matching subcomplex.
title: Mixed-dimensional integral homotopy of the sixteen-vertex Möbius-ladder matching complex
